scope: Current Rust project_save backend paired warm benchmark; debug test binaries only.

method.profile: Rust lib unit-test executable, dev/unoptimized profile on macOS arm64; not release.
method.samples: Baseline then candidate; each run: one excluded warm changed/no-op pair, then 10 alternating changed/no-op saves.
method.timing: std::time::Instant around the project_save save closure; operation medians/p95 are separate from whole test-harness runtime.
method.p95: nearest-rank percentile sorted[ceil(0.95*n)-1]; for n=10 this is the largest sample.
method.counters: Logical Rust file-API calls/bytes from in-memory counters. Per-target counts include project.json, .workspace/recovery.json, project.bak, and .workspace/recovery.bak.
limitations: Not Tauri IPC or GUI latency.
No physical-device bytes, cold-cache latency, RSS, or WebKit memory measured.
sync_ops are reported as the helper emits them; they are logical sync calls, not storage-device durability timing.
